evidence.source_statement: When the application persists valuable mutable state, verify its write/replace operations cannot silently corrupt prior valid state on interruption and that recovery of interrupted writes is supported or limitations disclosed.
source_conditions: An authorized Rust project is being created from scratch and the specified concern is part of its accepted purpose or supported user contract.

interpretation.situation_scope: Situations are not exhaustive triggers and do not narrow normative rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intents describe inferred objectives, not additional obligations.
interpretation.effective_rules: The source rule is not activated merely by publishing its mapping.
